summary: Re-verification after the author's revision: all five returned items are fixed in the current files, and every acceptance criterion is evidenced. First pass (2026-10-27T23:34Z): I reproduced the scientific core on 5 recordings disjoint from the author's (seed 4242: AB06/i0, AB02/i10, AB01/d5, AB09/i0, AB06/d10). Pelvis component 1 equals the ASIS/PSIS marker tilt. Hip - pelvis follows the leg markers in 10 of 10 legs, and pelvis + hip misses them by 2x tilt. Source power is anti-correlated with moment x joint speed. Force plates hold newtons and millimetres at 1000 Hz. Decline trials face -Y. The AB07/i10 right run reproduces exactly. Quotes are faithful, and the policy invents no offset or sign. Second pass: I re-checked the revised evidence report, probe JSON, author handoff and both rebuilt sheets, and independently re-read the 45/60/90 deg ankle screens. All bound output hashes match. Done means the convention report meets its acceptance criteria. It is not scientific approval of the dataset. D-UM21-C01-1 and D-UM21-C01-2 remain open for José.
checks: First pass (seed 4242, scratchpad verify_probe.py sha256 prefix e650a0abd8e28a59, verify_out.json prefix a21fc316a1e049e7). Pelvis c1 minus marker tilt: median -0.036 to +0.003 deg. Thigh: hip - pelvis closer in 10 of 10 legs (author recipe -7.7 to +5.0 deg; producer +14.6 to +54 deg). Power c1 against M1 x w1: r -0.979 to -1.000, slope -0.71 to -1.02 in 30 of 30 joint-sides. Ankle own-plate stance moment -0.68 to -0.82 N*m/kg in 10 of 10 legs. Plates: 10x rate, Fz -786 to -976 N, CoP in mm with z = 0 and a local (not marker-global) frame. Decline facing -Y by 3 marker cues. AB07/i10 R run 11712-17134 exact. Quotes: E1-E9 verbatim against paper.xml, README pypdf text, the Confluence REST pages 11611411 and 11605972, and git 330789e. Every mapping is x pi/180 or unchanged: no offset or sign is invented.

Integrity (second pass): sha256 of the probe JSON (15379327...), builder (547e5f96...), UM21-C01 index.html and fig1a-d, fig2, and D-UM21-C01-1 index.html, fig1 and fig2 equal the 'outputs' bound in um21-c01-tread-conventions.json. The probe 'code_sha256' equals the current builder.

Item 1 (ankle boundary): FIXED. I independently re-read LAnkleAngles for AB08/i0. |c1| > 45/60/90 deg gives 9/8/2 frames (13891-13899, 13892-13899, 13896-13897), matching the probe screen_sweep. The LHS events 13770/13899/14028 match the recorded touched strides. AB07/i10 R is 11712-17134 at all three screens, touching 34 right strides, which I recounted from RHS. The field policy adopts no screen and withholds the canonical ankle column for both whole recording-sides (AB07/i10 R, AB08/i0 L). The source copy keeps every frame, and no offset is applied.

Item 2 (Q7 prerequisite): FIXED. In handoffs/UM21-C01.json, D-UM21-C01-2 names the LocoHub moment sign rule in its question, why, and options B and C, and the why limits the independent sign check to the ankle. D-UM21-C01-1 option C names the segment-angle sign rule. The field_policy statuses for the moment, thigh and shank columns carry the same prerequisites. Both sheets show it in a 'Needs first' column.

Item 3 (bounds): FIXED. P1-P5, the handoff summary and the D-1 'why' state two-sample ranges: pelvis 95th percentile 0.2-3.2 deg, thigh median -7.7 to +5.0 deg ('about 8 degrees'), power slope -0.71 to -1.02 with 60 of 60 joint-sides anti-correlated. The chips use the median (within 0.1 deg) and a scoped per-leg range ('-5 to +4 deg in these legs'). The moment chip is now ankle-only.

Item 4 (P5 and count): FIXED. P5 records Methods 100 Hz against Table 2 1000 Hz against data 1000 Hz. P4 cites the Table 2 power definition. The author handoff summary and checks say 4 random recordings plus the lead.

Item 5 (sheets): FIXED. The mapping is 4 one-panel PNGs: standard, waiting, source-only, and a labeled made-up failure panel ('HipAngles 2nd (adduction)' as a wrong component; 'knee x -pi/180' as a flipped sign). That contrast matches the wrong-field/wrong-sign failure the figure asks about. Titles are 'Treadmill conventions check' and 'Thigh and shank decision'. Decision headings and reply lines are plain words, and no task or decision ID appears outside the folds (regex check). The chip says pelvis markers.

Sheet rules (second pass): fixed order kept. Chips 8 and 4, figures 2 and 1, not-shown items 3 and 2. Prose (ask, headline, captions, not-shown, footnote) is 52 and 44 words, under 60. Options are still ordered by a neutral attribute (amount made standard; strength of presentation), stated in builder comments at lines 368 and 399. The recommended option sits last (C) and in the middle (B), the recommendation is only in the fold, and the reply hints are neutral. No leak.

Rendering (second pass): google-chrome --headless=new --allow-file-access-from-files at 1100x3200 and inside a 390-px iframe wrapper. Files are in the scratchpad: rv_wide_UM21-C01.png, rv_phone_UM21-C01.png (crop rv_phone_UM21-C01_crop.png), rv_wide_D-UM21-C01-1.png and rv_phone_D-UM21-C01-1.png. At 390 px nothing clips; the mapping panels, ankle plot, recipe plots and stacked decision tables are legible. At 1100 px the layout is clean, but the 3-column mapping panels render small (about 8 px text; each image links to full size).

Acceptance criteria. (1) Every canonical mapping has model, unit and frame evidence: pelvis, hip and knee via E1/E7/E8/E9 and P1. (2) Ankle anomalies are preserved unshifted. (3) Unknown mappings stay source channels: powers, forces, plates, non-sagittal components and foot progression. (4) There is a field-by-field policy with canonical, derived, pending-decision and source-only statuses. (5) Exact evidence E1-E9 and correspondence questions Q1-Q7 are recorded. All are met.

At 1100 px the mapping panels are small; consider 2 columns or larger text in a later rebuild.
